```{r}
# Simuler un processus gamma par la méthode Random Walk Approximation (RWA)
source("simulate_rwa_gamma.R")
```


# Approche de d'Edith
```{r}
gamma_bridge <- function(X, t, a) {
  n <- length(X) - 1
  t_n <- t[length(t)]
  teq <- t_n / n
  
  t_star <- seq(0, t_n, teq)
  
  Y <- numeric(length(t_star))
  Y[1] <- 0
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    inter <- max(t[t <= t_star[i]])
    if (inter > t_star[i - 1]) {
      t_inf <- inter
      x_inf <- X[t == inter]
    } else {
      t_inf <- t_star[i - 1]
      x_inf <- Y[i - 1]
    }
    t_sup <- min(t[t > t_star[i]])
    x_sup <- X[t == t_sup]
    y <- rbeta(1, a * (t_star[i] - t_inf), a * (t_sup - t_star[i]))
    Y[i] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
  }
  Y[n + 1] <- X[n + 1]
  
  list(teq = teq, new_obs = Y)
}
```


# Simulation et comparaison graphique


```{r}
# Données
set.seed(46)
N <- 10
t_obs <- c(0, 1.2, 2, 3.8, 5.5, 7.1, 10.4, 12.9, 15.3, 18.7, 22.5)
a_true <- 3.2
b_true <- 0.8
sim_mat <- simulate_gamma_rwa(times = t_obs, a = a_true, nsim = 1, rate = b_true)
x_obs <- sim_mat[, 1]


bridge <- gamma_bridge(X = x_obs, t = t_obs, a = a_true)

df_obs <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_obs, type = "Points observés")
t_reg <- seq(0, max(t_obs), by = bridge$teq)
df_sim <- data.frame(t = t_reg, x = bridge$new_obs, type = "Points simulés")

```


```{r}
head(df_obs)

head(df_sim)
```


```{r}
# Graphique
library(ggplot2)
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_obs, aes(t, x, color = type), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = df_sim, aes(t, x, color = type), shape = 16, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Points observés" = "red", "Points simulés" = "blue")) +
  labs(title = "Méthode de Grall-Maes : Points observés vs Points simulés",
       x = "Temps", y = "X(t)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_blank())
```
